description: Default capability for the app windows. Grants the shell plugin so the worker sidecar can be spawned and managed; panel + nudge (P2.3) get the same window/core surface for the tray commands. `shell:allow-open` covers the http(s)/mailto fallback path of openExternal() — the macOS System Settings deep link goes through the app's own `open_external` command instead, because the plugin's JS open-scope only admits mailto/tel/http(s).
